suite: Module 29 Android preview suite (checkout) run again after Module 30 — Flutter web preview with PAYMENT_MODE=api — with the expectations Module 30 changed adapted (see m30-regression-runs.txt)
note: The same Dart code as the APK, run in the browser preview. The real device is verified by the owner (USER DEVICE VERIFICATION = PENDING).

results.name: A0 the app signs in against the local backend (same Dart code as the APK, CHECKOUT_MODE=api)
A1 the customer's cart (2 onion rings, 1 masala fries at Burger Hub) and a pickup slot exist on the backend
A2 the cart screen has no promo field of its own: a code is entered at checkout
B1 OPENING CHECKOUT ASKS THE BACKEND: POST /checkouts with an EMPTY body (no cart, no restaurant, no amount), the customer session and an idempotency key
B2 THE TOTAL ON THE SCREEN IS THE BACKEND'S: the bar shows ₹427.00 = the backend checkout total = the cart's server subtotal (nothing configured, nothing applied)
B3 THE BUTTON CARRIES THE BACKEND TOTAL: "Continue to payment · ₹427.00"
B4 NOTHING IS INVENTED: no tax line, no fee line, no discount; the screen says no taxes or fees are configured

B5 the screen shows the backend's customer, restaurant, pickup time and lines, the three legal documents (drafts pending approval), the payment-method types — and no "payments unavailable" note (the backend says the provider is READY)
B6 no development-checkout label, no delivery fee, no "tax invoice", no GST / VAT wording, no cash at pickup; the documents carry the backend's version

results.name: B7 a draft holds nothing
C1 APPLY WELCOME10: the app sends only the code; the backend takes 10 % off and the bar shows the backend total
C2 an expired code is refused by the backend (422 promotion_expired): the screen says so, and the applied code and its total stay
C3 REMOVE: the backend prices the checkout again without the code
D1 WITHOUT ACCEPTING THE TERMS nothing is confirmed: no confirm request leaves the phone and the screen says what is missing
D2 CONFIRM sends the fingerprint of the price on the screen, the three documents with their versions and a method TYPE — no amount, no currency, no customer; with an idempotency key
D3 READY on the backend: acceptance recorded, payment PREPARED for exactly the total (payment provider READY, no attempt yet) and ONE place held in the slot until the checkout expires
D4 THE PAYMENT STEP is the backend's payment screen (Module 30): "Ready to pay" with the backend total of the confirmed checkout — nothing has been started or charged by arriving on it

results.name: D5 back on checkout the confirmed checkout is shown with its held pickup time

E1 THE RESTAURANT RAISES A PRICE; the app comes back to the foreground: it asks the backend (GET /checkouts/{id}), the checkout is STALE, a new one is opened and the bar shows the NEW total — with a notice that the price changed. The old hold is released
E2 the price goes back and the checkout follows
E3 THE RESTAURANT MARKS AN ITEM SOLD OUT: checkout is BLOCKED — the backend's reason with the way back to the cart, the button is disabled and no total is shown

E4 AN ADMINISTRATOR ACTIVATES A TEST FEE (₹15) AND A TEST TAX (5 %): the app shows a fee line and a tax line, the total is subtotal + fee + tax (calculated independently here with integers, half up) and the screen calls it a TEST configuration
E5 the rules are disabled again: no tax, no fee
F1 EXPIRY ON THE SERVER CLOCK: the checkout's time is over — the app says it expired, the button is disabled, and the backend answers EXPIRED
F2 "Start again" asks the backend for a new checkout: a new id, the current total, the button is back
F3 NO CONNECTION: back in the app the backend cannot be asked — the screen says so and the button is disabled; a checkout cannot be continued on an unconfirmed total
F4 with the connection back the backend is asked again and the checkout can be continued

F5 A TOTAL OF ZERO (a 100 % test promotion): no payment method is asked for, the button says "Confirm — nothing to pay", the confirmation carries no payment method, the backend answers PAYMENT_NOT_REQUIRED and the app does NOT go to a payment step
